rows.question: What is photometrically observed star
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  p.objid,
  p.run,
  p.rerun,
  p.field,
  p.mode,
  p.type,
  t.name AS type_name,
  p.ra,
  p.dec,
  p.u,
  p.g,
  p.r,
  p.i,
  p.z,
  p.clean
FROM photoobj p
LEFT JOIN photo_type t ON p.type = t.value
WHERE p.clean IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    lower(coalesce(t.name, '')) IN ('star', 'stars')
    OR lower(coalesce(t.description, '')) LIKE '%star%'
  )

  p.rerun,
  p.field,
  p.mode,
  p.type,
  p.clean,
  p.flags,
  p.rowc,

  p.ra,
  p.dec,
  p.u,

  p.r,
  p.i,
  p.z
FROM photoobj p
JOIN (

WHERE p.clean = 1

  AND NOT (p.u IS NULL AND p.g IS NULL AND p.r IS NULL AND p.i IS NULL AND p.z IS NULL)

rows.question: Find all photometrically observable star that have spectral observations. Retrieve the object id, right ascension, and declination.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT p.objid,
       p.ra,
       p.dec
FROM photoobj p
JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(bestobjid, specobjid) AS objid
  FROM specobj
  WHERE bestobjid IS NOT NULL OR specobjid IS NOT NULL
) s ON s.objid = p.objid
WHERE p.ra IS NOT NULL
  AND p.dec IS NOT NULL

rows.question: Show me the object id, right ascension, and declination of photometrically observed star that have spectral observations.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  p.objid AS object_id,
  p.ra    AS right_ascension,
  p.dec   AS declination
FROM photoobj p
JOIN photo_type pt
  ON p.type = pt.value
JOIN specobj s
  ON s.bestobjid = p.objid
WHERE p.objid IS NOT NULL
  AND p.ra IS NOT NULL
  AND p.dec IS NOT NULL
  AND pt.name ILIKE '%star%'
ORDER BY p.objid ASC

rows.pred_sql:

  SELECT value, name
  FROM photo_type
),
photoobj_core AS (
  SELECT
    objid,
    ra,
    dec,
    type
  FROM photoobj
),
spectroscopic_objects_core AS (
  SELECT
    specobjid,
    bestobjid
  FROM specobj
)

rows.question: Find the number of photometrically observed GALAXY whose magnitude r is less than 17, extinction r is greater than 0.2.

  SELECT
    pt.value AS value,
    pt.name AS name
  FROM photo_type pt
),
photoobj_base AS (
  SELECT
    p.objid AS objid,
    p.r AS r,
    p.extinction_r AS extinction_r,
    p.type AS type,
    p.clean AS clean,
    p.ra AS ra,
    p.dec AS dec
  FROM photoobj p
  WHERE p.objid IS NOT NULL
    AND p.clean > 0
    AND p.ra IS NOT NULL
    AND p.dec IS NOT NULL
)

FROM photoobj_base p
JOIN photo_type_lookup t ON p.type = t.value
WHERE t.name = 'GALAXY'
  AND p.r < 17
  AND p.extinction_r > 0.2

rows.pred_sql:
SELECT p.objid,
       p.ra,
       p.dec
FROM photoobj p
INNER JOIN specobj s
  ON s.bestobjid = p.objid
WHERE s.class = 'GALAXY'
  AND p.g > 17.0
  AND p.g < 18.0
  AND s.z < 0.05
ORDER BY p.objid
